protocol.purpose: full-loader multi-seed functional-update calibration followed by longer paired-seed quality confirmation
protocol.calibration_metric: arithmetic mean highest-FP32 fixed-input delta-update RMS across 6 blocks, steps 50/100/250/500, and seeds 48/49
protocol.selection: closest absolute log(mean update / reference target); no loss, validation, FID or class agreement
protocol.correction: clip(previous multiplier * target / previous mean update, 1/16, 16)

auxiliary_classifier.purpose: fixed auxiliary evaluator of generated requested-class agreement
auxiliary_classifier.retention: one frozen evaluator and its compact training records until explicitly removed

protocol.estimated_new_gpu_hours: 6–9 including validation and final quality evaluation
protocol.ema: in-memory .999 only; no new evaluator weights
protocol.retention: compact source/configs/splits/metrics/logs/reports and one 100-image grid per confirmation until explicitly removed
limits: Calibration matches a scalar aggregate; individual seeds, blocks and later updates can drift.
Three training seeds and one held-out split; sample SD is not a confidence interval.
Finite 5,000-image FID; one fixed sampling seed; auxiliary classifier agreement is a proxy.
Rates are update-selected, not quality-optimized; gains are empirical choices, not a variance-preservation or muP guarantee.
Concurrent throughput is not an isolated speed comparison; equal steps are not equal wall-clock budgets.
Warmup 50 differs from the earlier 30k study's warmup 500; only current controls are recipe-matched.
Broadcast class/time conditioning only; sequence-valued cross-attention remains untested.

rows.conditioning: normalized learned class-plus-timestep vector; common AdaLN heads and residual gates

generative_evaluation.fid_reference: held-out training split; official test untouched
generative_evaluation.fid_feature_input: uint8 RGB [0,255]; float32 Inception, float64 moment accumulation; antialias=True
generative_evaluation.fid_interpretation: finite-sample pilot; not directly comparable to published 50k-image FID

classifier.purpose: fixed auxiliary evaluator of generated requested-class agreement
classifier.retention: one frozen evaluator and its compact training records until explicitly removed

class_agreement.input: unquantized RGB32 [0,1], CIFAR mean/std, FP32 classifier
class_agreement.interpretation: Auxiliary classifier agreement, not human class accuracy; limited by classifier errors and domain shift.

rows.training_memory_includes: model, in-memory EMA, gradients, optimizer and training activations; excludes FID; fixed diagnostic inputs; diagnostic forwards excluded from peaks

design_diagnostics.fixed_function_probe_precision: FP32 tensors and highest FP32 matmul precision; no autocast
design_diagnostics.scope: fixed independent normalized inputs/conditions; live diagnostic validation images; not EMA updates

rows.diagnostic_timing: diagnostic probes and logging excluded from train windows; included in loop_seconds

limitations: One fixed validation split; seed spread is not a confidence interval or test-set estimate.
FID uses held-out train images and finite sample counts; not published 50k-image FID.
Wrong-class loss measures sensitivity/use, not generated class accuracy.
External condition is a single class/time vector; sequence-conditioned cross-attention is not evaluated.
Concurrent throughput shares CPU/storage; matrix FLOPs omit non-matmul work and backward.
Generative evaluation time includes sampling and FID feature/statistic computation; isolated inference throughput is not measured.
Each screen has its own declared LR/initialization recipe; optimal rates are not established without bracketing.

limits: Calibration matches a scalar aggregate; individual seeds, blocks and later updates can drift.
Three training seeds and one held-out split; sample SD is not a confidence interval.
Finite 5,000-image FID; one fixed sampling seed; auxiliary classifier agreement is a proxy.
Rates are update-selected, not quality-optimized; gains are empirical choices, not a variance-preservation or muP guarantee.
Concurrent throughput is not an isolated speed comparison; equal steps are not equal wall-clock budgets.
Warmup 50 differs from the earlier 30k study's warmup 500; only current controls are recipe-matched.
Broadcast class/time conditioning only; sequence-valued cross-attention remains untested.
